item.title: Literal Colon URL
item.description:
This page is stored below content/en/posts/hugo-136-url-escapes/, but its front matter renders it at /posts/hugo-136/literal:colon/.

The example keeps the content local and deterministic while exercising the theme’s list links, breadcrumbs, canonical URLs, and processed eyecatch image output with Hugo v0.136 escaped-colon URL handling.
